angular_rate_basis: 23 deg joint range divided by the accepted P16 proxy transition time 8.3 s (40 mm stroke); linkage force/speed variation is excluded

load_cases.empty: dynamic tilt; launcher present; empty basket
load_cases.full45: dynamic tilt; launcher present; 2.565 kg 45-ball equivalent basket payload
load_cases.ballast: spawn/stability-only; fixed chassis ballast; no launcher tilt evidence

criteria.name: dwell_joint_target_error
criteria.rationale: Half of the frozen 1 degree indexed lower-stop pitch is the maximum acceptable endpoint ambiguity.
criteria.source: P2-39/P2-40 indexed lower stop -10..-3 deg in 1 deg increments.

criteria.name: forbidden_launcher_contact_count
criteria.rationale: The frozen mechanical requirement is physical separation >=8 mm; any simulated contact contradicts that discrete requirement and triggers model/frame investigation.
criteria.source: P2-40 frozen clearance requirement >=8 mm; predicted residual >=11 mm is not used as a Gazebo threshold.

criteria.name: nan_or_inf_state_count
criteria.rationale: Non-finite state is numerical instability, not physical evidence.

criteria.name: joint_limit_violation
criteria.rationale: The accepted operating range is exactly -3 to +20 degrees and terminal impact is excluded.

criteria.name: absolute_roll
criteria.rationale: Retains the accepted 5a chassis stability gate.

criteria.name: absolute_pitch
criteria.rationale: Retains the accepted 5a chassis stability gate.

criteria.name: tilt_command_torque
criteria.rationale: The approved abstract actuator effort limit.
criteria.source: P2-42 user decision and existing ros2_control effort interface.

criteria.name: settling_time
criteria.rationale: No accepted loaded P16 settling requirement exists; report only.
criteria.source: P16 physical dynamics explicitly excluded from 5b.

criteria.name: overshoot
criteria.rationale: Report controller behaviour without inventing a mechanical acceptance bound.

criteria.name: contact_force
criteria.rationale: No calibrated stiffness or physical force requirement exists.

criteria.name: chassis_horizontal_displacement
criteria.rationale: Robot is commanded stationary, but no calibrated floor-drift bound exists.
